description: ClauDHD: Focus and drift control for Claude Code.

plugins.name: claudhd
plugins.description: A NOW cursor that follows your branch, an idea inbox you can backfill from past sessions, a project roadmap, a shipped log, mid-session regroup, end-of-session wrap-up, and branch-aware session breadcrumbs, so stopping mid-thought is always safe.
